notes: Posture sweep, src/Prompt.ts neighborhood. .flume/chain.ts:54 hardcodes "prior-attempts", duplicating Dispatcher.ts's private PRIOR_ATTEMPTS_SUBDIR that priorAttemptPath (Dispatcher.ts:659) already exists to encapsulate for exactly this reason (its own doc comment: "no private dispatcher rule to reverse-engineer").
